label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf) alert-TP: endpoint variable derives directly from request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest") and flows to the URL sink. The mitigation checks if the resolved IP is non-public (loopback/site-local/etc.), but this negative filtering allows any public IP. Public IPs can still point to internal resources (e.g., cloud metadata services) or be subject to DNS rebinding, making the sink value attacker-controlled and exploitable.

evidence.note: User input param assigned to endpoint, resolved via DNS, then used in URL sink without positive allowlist
